newsitem.title: YUGOSLAVIA: Serbian parliament adopts deal with Bosnia Serbs.
newsitem.headline: Serbian parliament adopts deal with Bosnia Serbs.

text.p: The Serbian parliament on Monday endorsed a cooperation agreement between Federal Yugoslavia and the Bosnian Serb Republic and said it would reinforce regional stability, Tanjug news agency reported.
It urged the federal parliament to ratify the accord which has to be accepted also by the Bosnian parliament representing all three communities in the former Yugoslav republic.
The Yugoslav parliament is expected to vote on the agreement on March 20.
